system: An observed system; the public fixture uses abstract System A.
role: Read component views; shared hidden state does not make correlated component views independent evidence.

contract.cutoff: Only records with observed_at and available_at no later than cutoff enter Lab.
contract.numeric: target_id,value,unit; preserve zero and negative finite values.
contract.missingness: Missing observations remain missing; never impute a successful evaluation.
contract.uncertainty: Model uncertainty is distinct from measurement provenance.
contract.future: Predictions freeze snapshot_value,target_value,unit and explicit target_time_iso.
